signals.name: Nasdaq 100
signals.label: Turn-of-month flow
signals.entry_txt: Open of the last trading day of the month.
signals.exit_txt: Exit at the close of the 3rd trading day of the new month; catastrophe stop 2 ATR.
signals.why: Turn-of-the-month effect (Lakonishok-Smidt 1988; McConnell-Xu 2008): pension/payroll flows concentrate equity returns in the last day + first 3 days of the month.
reasons: Tomorrow is the last trading day of the month (turn-of-month window opens)
History on Nasdaq 100: 240 trades, hit 54% (95% CI 47-60%), avg +0.07R net of costs
Out-of-sample (last 30% of trades): +0.05R per trade
In the current extreme-volatility regime: 20 trades, avg -0.02R
signals.invalidation: Thesis is wrong if price trades below 24,998.65 (=-1R) or nothing happens by 2026-12-03.

signals.label: IBS reversal (close at extreme)
signals.exit_txt: Stop 1.5 ATR, target 1 ATR, time-stop 3 sessions.
signals.why: Internal Bar Strength: closes near the day's extreme tend to revert next days, strongest in equity indices (Pagonidis 2013; documented in index futures/ETFs).
reasons: Closed in the top of today's range (IBS 0.93)
